text:
Infra Bot: Pager: P1 -> inference-pool-prod | node/inf-node-47 NotReady (kubelet restart flapping)

Alice Kim: noticed alerts ~2m ago, p50 latency jumped and 502s spiking. paging now.

Samir Patel: on it, pulling up node list and pod status.

Marta Lopez: I'm here, watching customer error rates. which region?

Alice Kim: US-W -> node inf-node-47 and inf-node-49 toggling NotReady. traffic steering kicked in but capacity reduced.

Samir Patel: running quick checks:
```
$ kubectl get nodes -o wide | egrep "inf-node-4[79]"
inf-node-47   Ready,SchedulingDisabled   2d   v1.26.3   10.10.47.5   <none>   <none>
inf-node-49   NotReady                    3h   v1.26.3   10.10.49.3   <none>   <none>
```

Samir Patel: kubelet logs from inf-node-49 show repeated restarts, attaching tail:
```
Mar 15 14:05:21 inf-node-49 systemd[1]: kubelet.service: main process exited, code=exited, status=1/FAILURE
Mar 15 14:05:21 inf-node-49 systemd[1]: kubelet.service: Failed with result 'exit-code'.
Mar 15 14:05:22 inf-node-49 systemd[1]: kubelet.service: Scheduled restart job, restart counter is 3.
...
Apr 15 14:07:10 kernel: [ 12345.678901] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus.
```

Marta Lopez: GPU driver errors -> potential CUDA/NVRM. customers seeing generation failures or timeouts?

Alice Kim: yes, errors are 502/timeout on generation endpoint, errors up ~4.8% over baseline for the last 5m. Affected keys mostly in us-west-2.

Ops Oncall: I'm going to cordon inf-node-49 and drain any remaining inference pods to avoid further restarts. leaving one replica so autoscaler can move traffic.

Samir Patel: command:
```
kubectl cordon inf-node-49
kubectl drain inf-node-49 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force --grace-period=30
```

Infra Bot: Deploy Bot triggered routing policy change: moved 30% of traffic from us-west-2 -> fallback-dedicated-pool.

Marta Lopez: good. starting a manual scale of fallback pool to absorb steady traffic.

Alice Kim: also enabling aggressive prefix caching for us-west-2 to reduce token churn.

Samir Patel: I'm SSHing into inf-node-49 to check driver state and systemd status.

Samir Patel: ssh output:
```
$ ssh root@10.10.49.3
# systemctl status kubelet -l
● kubelet.service - kubelet: loaded
   Active: failed (Result: exit-code) since Apr 15 14:07:10; 3min ago
# sudo dmesg | tail -n 40
[12345.678901] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus.
[12345.678940] NVRM: GPU at 0000:65:00: GPU has fallen off the bus.
```

Samir Patel: looks like the GPU driver crashed, causing kubelet to fail due to pod-level device plugin faults. Could be a driver bug or thermal/power issue.

Marta Lopez: can we restart kubelet after driver restart? any risk of repeated OOMs?

Samir Patel: I'll attempt a safe sequence: restart nvidia driver (modprobe -r nvidia && modprobe nvidia) then start kubelet. If it flaps again, escalate to infra and consider marking node for reprovision.

Alice Kim: Meanwhile I'm opening an incident timeline and notifying cs for high-visibility customers. putting runbook steps in incident doc.

Ops Oncall: doing the drain now; pods rescheduled to inf-fallback-01/02. errors should drop in next 1-2min.

Infra Bot: Deployment change recorded: route adjustment id=rt-2026-04-15-01 by Deploy Bot.

Samir Patel: attempting driver unload/load:
```
sudo systemctl stop kubelet
sudo rmmod nvidia_uvm nvidia_drm nvidia
sudo modprobe nvidia
sudo modprobe nvidia_drm nvidia_uvm
sudo systemctl start kubelet
```

Samir Patel: kubelet start succeeded, node transitions to Ready. kernel still shows occasional Xid 79 warnings but lower frequency.

Marta Lopez: monitoring metrics now. initial customer error rate dropping from 4.8% -> 1.2% in last 3mins. p50 latency slowly trending down.

Alice Kim: Samir, please leave node cordoned until we confirm stability for 30m and run daily health checks. Also create a ticket for infra to investigate hardware and driver telemetry.

Samir Patel: created ticket INFRA-2026: GPU driver Xid 79 flaps on inf-node-49, attaching dmesg and kubelet logs. tagging infra-team.

Ops Oncall: handing off to night oncall @Marta for monitoring. I'll summarize steps in the handoff: 1) node cordoned 2) driver reload + kubelet restart 3) traffic routed to fallback pool 4) ticket INFRA-2026 created 5) monitor for 30m before uncordon.

Marta Lopez: ack. I'll keep watch and escalate if Xid 79 reappears.

Alice Kim: CS notified: high-touch customers flagged; mitigation in progress. Will follow up on post-incident RCA.

Infra Bot: NOTE: Next poll will run in 5m for node readiness and GPU telemetry.

Samir Patel: one more note — we should consider pinning driver version or applying a kernel patch to mitigate known NVRM 79 regressions; adding to INFRA-2026.

Marta Lopez: thanks team. handing off fully to Ops Oncall for dark hours.

Alice Kim: closing the pager for now — status: mitigated, customer impact reduced but not fully resolved. keeping incident open for RCA. :white_check_mark:
